mapper.sql: id, event_key, topic, payload, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, last_error, lease_owner, lease_until, lease_version, created_time, updated_time, sent_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_comment_outbox (event_key, topic, payload, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, lease_version, created_time, updated_time) VALUES (#{eventKey}, #{topic}, #{payload}, 'PENDING', 0, NOW(), 0, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_comment_outbox WHERE event_key = #{eventKey}
SELECT FROM t_comment_outbox WHERE (status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'SENDING' AND lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_comment_outbox SET status = 'SENDING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, lease_version = lease_version + 1, updated_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND ((status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'SENDING' AND lease_until <= #{now}))
UPDATE t_comment_outbox SET payload = '', updated_time = NOW() WHERE status = 'SENT' AND sent_time < #{cutoff} AND payload != '' ORDER BY sent_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
